title: introduce-lightweight-credential-bridge-and-async-pullstream-helpers
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: teams keep re-implementing small credential handoffs and patterny async-iterable helpers across SDKs. This PR introduces a lightweight credential bridge (a small, zero-dependency runtime shim) plus a compact set of async pullstream helpers intended to be re-used by Python/TS/Go SDKs. Goals: 1) Reduce duplicated glue inside each SDK; 2) Provide a single, well-tested primitive for credential rotation + graceful stream restart; 3) Surface ergonomic helpers for common consumer patterns (buffered iteration, drain-with-timeout, checkpointing cursors). What this PR delivers (single-line list): - cred/bridge: portable credential exchange interface + in-memory lease cache - stream/pull: async pullstream helpers (prefetcher, checkpoint cursor, drainWithDeadline) - sdk-adapters: small adapters used by TS/Python SDKs (no runtime deps) - tests: focused unit tests and cross-language integration harnesses - docs: migration note + README with usage examples Checklist: - [x] interface design and tests - [x] local cross-sdk harness run (python, ts) - [x] API stability review with platform - [x] performance microbenchmarks and allocation profile - [x] doc snippets and migration guide Compatibility notes: no breaking API changes in public SDKs; SDK repos will adopt the bridge via small adapter PRs (follow-ups listed below). See linked Linear items for rollout plan and telemetry.

files_changed_summary: Adds a small cred bridge package, cross-language pullstream helpers, lightweight adapters used by SDKs, and tests/docs. No large binary artifacts. Total ~8 new source files across cred/stream/sdk-adapters plus CI and docs updates.
review_comments: Liam Chen: Could you explain how the lease cache handles clock skew across nodes? Suggest adding a small jitter to renewal windows.
Maya Patel (reply): Added jitter logic to the in-memory lease cache and a unit test simulating skewed timers. Kept jitter configurable and disabled by default for test determinism.
Rosa Alvarez: The TS prefetcher looked like it may hold onto memory if downstream stalls. Please add a max-buffer-size option and backpressure signal.
Maya Patel (reply): Added maxBuffer option and a backpressure promise that pauses upstream fetches; included an example in README explaining tradeoffs.
Evan Miles: CI matrix flaked on Linux/Py3.11 worker. I re-ran and it passed; consider adding a short retry on the flakey integ harness step.
Maya Patel (reply): Added a single-retry wrapper for the harness start step and logged retries explicitly.
release_notes: Introduce a lightweight credential bridge and cross-language async pullstream helpers to standardize credential rotation and stream ergonomics. SDKs will adopt via small adapter PRs. No breaking changes. Includes migration docs and examples.
